summary: Lycoming County, PA steel Aermotor fire tower erected 1921 on Holmes Hill; moved in 1938 and renamed Sprout Point, where it was removed in 1985.

facts.status_note: Moved in 1938 and renamed Sprout Point; the Sprout Point tower was removed in 1985. No source describes the Holmes Hill site today.

staffing.status: Towerman M.E. McNett of Leolyn named in an April 1922 newspaper item

events.note: Erected for the forestry department; hauled by truck to its Holmes Hill site, per an Aug 4, 1921 newspaper item
M.E. McNett of Leolyn named as towerman in an April 20, 1922 item
Oct 16, 1937 item (Gazette and Bulletin) said the Holmes Hurst tower near Masten would be dismantled after the fall season and a new tower erected on Sprout Point
FFLOS: moved in 1938 and renamed Sprout Point; the Sprout Point entry also gives 1938 as its build year
The Sprout Point tower, the structure moved from Holmes Hurst, was removed in 1985 per FFLOS

corrections.why: FFLOS gives no coordinates for Holmes Hurst. The stored point is within about 0.0002 degrees of Sprout Point's FFLOS coordinates (41.478688, -76.801903), so it may mark the later site, not Holmes Hill.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1937 newspaper item says the Holmes Hurst tower would be dismantled after the fall season and a new one erected on Sprout Point. FFLOS gives 1938 for the move and for the Sprout Point build. The story follows FFLOS for 1938 and notes the gap.

notes_for_editor: Dates for the move differ by about a year between the 1937 newspaper item and FFLOS. The Holmes Hill site has no coordinates in any source read; the stored point matches Sprout Point, so treat the record location as suspect. Newspaper items are quoted on Forest Lookouts and were not checked against originals. WebSearch found nothing on Holmes Hurst or the 1985 removal. No source describes either site today.
